theme_stances.key_argument: Bessent is using tactical Treasury interventions to force a massive CTA short squeeze to lower yields before the midterms.
theme_stances.evidence: Trigger a jump in prices, which becomes reinforcing and cascades into a full-blown CTA squeeze

theme_stances.key_argument: The intervention is a form of financial repression that suppresses market signals rather than resolving the underlying fiscal contradiction.
theme_stances.evidence: policymakers attempting to suppress the market signal rather than resolve the underlying contradiction

theme_stances.key_argument: Tactical buybacks cannot offset the structural upward pressure on yields caused by deficits and inflation.
theme_stances.evidence: The Treasury's extraordinary announcement to unexpectedly boost buybacks has only temporarily interrupted the rise in yields.

theme_stances.key_argument: Buybacks will offset 30% of supply but do not address fundamental macro drivers of yields.
theme_stances.evidence: Buybacks do not address the fundamental drivers and macro risks

theme_stances.evidence: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent long-end buybacks
